import subprocess
import threading

def run_install(argv):
    subprocess.run(argv)

def run_query(argv):
    subprocess.run(argv)

target = run_install
t1 = threading.Thread(target=target, args=(["pacman", "-S", "r22-reuse-a"],))
target = run_query
t2 = threading.Thread(target=target, args=(["pacman", "-Q", "r22-reuse-b"],))
t1.start()
t2.start()
